usedFor: Evenium holds your event guests, and WhatsApp Business Cloud messages them when “New Guests Added” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Guests Added” in Evenium, then “Send Template Message” in WhatsApp Business Cloud
bestTemplate.why: Each added guest gets a template message sent through your WhatsApp Business Cloud account.

watchOut: “Guest Created or Updated” also fires on edits, so prefer “New Guests Added” to avoid repeat messages.
